jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Development Representative
jobs.content: <div class="content-intro"><p>Our <a href="https://www.greenhouse.com/mission" target="_blank">mission</a> at Greenhouse is to make hiring work for everyone – so we go to great lengths to hire great people because we believe that they’re the foundation of our success. At Greenhouse, you’ll join a team that collaborates purposefully, fosters inclusivity, and communicates with transparency and accountability so we can achieve our mission.</p
jobs.ai_disclaimer: This hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision-making.
